success.support_requirement: both exact forearm cylinder colliders in contact and each upward force > 1e-6 N; at most 0.12 seconds continuous contact loss including startup (not two additive windows). Hand-end spheres may touch as auxiliary contact but do not count as forearm support
success.disallowed_support: any payload contact with floor, torso or other robot geometry fails immediately; only the two forearm cylinders and their left/right_hand_end_collision spheres are permitted

disturbance.description: Every 3-5 s (per environment, timer restarts at reset) the robot root link velocity gains a uniform delta in [-0.3, 0.3] m/s on each horizontal axis. Instantaneous, mass-independent kick on the robot only; the box is disturbed through contact.

notes: Same task, success criteria, masses, seeds and episode counts as team_protocol.json; only the pushes are added.
Report these success rates separately from the no-push baseline; never merge the two protocols.
The first push can land as early as 3 s, so a policy must already be settled by then.
The kick magnitude is an evaluation convention, not a measured real-world disturbance.

The box starts 1 cm in front of the trunk and friction (mu 0.7) can only close a relative speed v over v^2/(2 mu g) of slip, about 0.37 m/s for 1 cm. Larger forward kicks push the box into the trunk before any policy can react and are failed by the contact rule, not by balance.
